proposals.subtype: Obsolete data-valued update overloads always throw
proposals.explanation: Declares hidden obsolete sync/async Update overloads accepting ArcExtensionData that unconditionally throw NotSupportedException and direct callers to a patch-valued overload; they do not start an LRO.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The throwing overloads are explicitly supplied in Custom/ArcExtensionResource.cs.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete upgrade overloads cast the content before forwarding
proposals.explanation: Adds hidden obsolete Upgrade/UpgradeAsync overloads accepting ExtensionUpgradeContent, casting it to ArcExtensionUpgradeContent and forwarding WaitUntil and cancellation; the conversion implementation and operation polling are not supplied.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The cast and forwarding bodies are in the Custom resource partial outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Active directive suppresses a particular reported-properties factory signature
proposals.explanation: Declares CodeGenSuppress for the HciReportedProperties signature including nullable edge-device state, ExtensionProfile, binary-data dictionary and network/OS/deployment/storage/hardware arguments. The compiler-error and issue comments are not independently verified.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The active factory-class attribute is supplied in Custom/ArmHciModelFactory.cs rather than only described in a comment.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete extension-instance-view factory always throws
proposals.explanation: Declares a hidden obsolete HciExtensionInstanceView factory with optional name, type, handler version and status arguments; its body throws NotSupportedException naming ArcExtensionInstanceView.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: This explicit factory stub is in the Custom model-factory partial.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete per-node extension factory always throws
proposals.explanation: Declares an obsolete PerNodeExtensionState factory accepting name, extension, handler version, state and instance view; it throws NotSupportedException rather than constructing a model.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The obsolete declaration and throwing body are handwritten in Custom/ArmHciModelFactory.cs.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete extension-status factory always throws

proposals.handwrittenRationale: The factory's annotations and body are explicitly supplied in Custom source.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete remote-support factory signature always throws
proposals.explanation: Retains a hidden obsolete RemoteSupportNodeSettings factory accepting arc ID, state, timestamps, connection status/error and transcript location, but unconditionally throws and requests a different overload.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The parameter list and throwing implementation occur in the Custom model factory.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete offer factory still constructs a model and copies SKU mappings
proposals.explanation: The hidden obsolete OfferData factory constructs OfferData with null raw-data storage, reordered provisioning fields and a new List<HciSkuMappings> when skuMappings is nonnull, preserving null otherwise; unlike adjacent stubs, this factory does not unconditionally throw.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The constructor adaptation and collection copy are implemented in Custom/ArmHciModelFactory.cs.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete publisher-data factory always throws
proposals.explanation: Declares a hidden obsolete PublisherData factory with ARM metadata and provisioning state that throws NotSupportedException and names HciClusterPublisherData as the replacement.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The factory stub is explicitly written in the Custom model-factory partial.

proposals.subtype: Publisher factory adapts provisioning state into nested properties
proposals.explanation: Constructs HciClusterPublisherData from optional ARM metadata, building PublisherProperties(provisioningState,default) only when provisioningState is nonnull, and supplying default for the final constructor argument.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: This nonthrowing factory implementation is handwritten in the Custom model factory. Comments about service API removal are not needed to establish the implementation.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete binary-connectivity factory always throws
proposals.explanation: Retains a hidden obsolete ArcSettingData factory including BinaryData connectivityProperties and the listed identity/node/extension arguments, but always throws and names an ArcConnectivityProperties overload.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The obsolete overload signature and throwing body are in the Custom model factory.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete resource-identifier deployment factory always throws
proposals.explanation: Retains a hidden obsolete HciClusterDeploymentSettingData factory with IEnumerable<ResourceIdentifier> arcNodeResourceIds, but throws and names a replacement taking IEnumerable<string>.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The explicit obsolete factory overload is supplied in Custom/ArmHciModelFactory.cs.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete update-data factory always throws
proposals.explanation: Declares a hidden obsolete UpdateData factory with the listed metadata, update, health, package and progress arguments; it always throws and names HciClusterUpdateData.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The complete signature and stub body are present in the Custom model factory.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete update-run factory always throws

proposals.subtype: Obsolete update-summary factory always throws

proposals.subtype: Publisher pageables follow response next links with resume-token support
proposals.explanation: The sync/async pageables construct an initial Uri from a nonnull input continuation, loop through initial/next requests, parse PublisherList.NextLink and expose absolute or original URI text as the outgoing continuation. They stop on a null response or null next link. The pageSizeHint reaches a helper but is not used to construct either request.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Both complete pager implementations are handwritten under Custom/CollectionResults rather than Generated.

proposals.subtype: ArmClient extension constructs an ID-bound publisher resource through mocking
proposals.explanation: Adds GetHciClusterPublisherResource on ArmClient, null-checking the client and delegating through the mockable entry point, which calls resource-ID validation and constructs HciClusterPublisherResource(Client,id). No explicit data retrieval appears in these entry-point bodies; the resource constructor implementation is not supplied.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Both the public extension and resource-construction entry point are supplied in Custom/Extensions.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete offer entry points always throw
proposals.explanation: Both the hidden obsolete ArmClient GetOfferResource extension and mockable method throw NotSupportedException naming GetHciClusterOfferResource; no resource is constructed.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The paired public/mocking entry-point stubs are explicit in Custom/Extensions.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete publisher entry points always throw
proposals.explanation: The hidden obsolete GetPublisherResource extension and mockable method both throw NotSupportedException naming GetHciClusterPublisherResource, unlike the working new entry point.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: These distinct old-name public stubs are implemented in the Custom extension partials.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete update entry points always throw
proposals.explanation: The hidden obsolete GetUpdateResource extension and mockable method throw NotSupportedException naming GetHciClusterUpdateResource.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Both corresponding stubs are explicit in Custom/Extensions outside Generated.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete update-run entry points always throw
proposals.explanation: The hidden obsolete GetUpdateRunResource extension and mockable method throw NotSupportedException naming GetHciClusterUpdateRunResource.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The paired method implementations occur in the Custom extension/mocking partials.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete update-summary entry points always throw
proposals.explanation: The hidden obsolete GetUpdateSummaryResource extension and mockable method throw NotSupportedException naming GetHciClusterUpdateSummaryResource.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The old-name throwing declarations are explicitly supplied in Custom/Extensions.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete principal-ID property declares a nested identity wire path
proposals.explanation: Declares a hidden obsolete nullable-Guid PrincipalId property with a getter and WirePath("identity.principalId"), directing callers to Identity. The declaration is observed, not its generated serialization or a historical flattening change.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The active property and nested mapping are supplied in Custom/HciClusterData.cs.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete tenant-ID property declares a nested identity wire path
proposals.explanation: Declares a hidden obsolete get-only nullable-Guid TenantId property mapped by WirePath("identity.tenantId") and annotated to recommend Identity.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The property and nested wire-path attribute are explicit in Custom source.

proposals.subtype: Obsolete identity-type property declares the identity.type mapping
proposals.explanation: Declares hidden obsolete read/write TypeIdentityType of nullable HciManagedServiceIdentityType with WirePath("identity.type"); no accessor forwarding implementation is supplied in this partial.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The active property declaration and mapping occur in Custom/HciClusterData.cs.

proposals.explanation: Declares a hidden obsolete get-only IDictionary<string,UserAssignedIdentity> UserAssignedIdentities property with a nested identity.userAssignedIdentities WirePath. No constructor population or copying implementation is supplied here.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The dictionary API and mapping are handwritten in the Custom data partial.

proposals.subtype: Publisher collection binds a REST client and API-version fallback
proposals.explanation: Declares an ArmCollection with sync/async enumerable interfaces, a protected empty constructor and an internal ArmClient/id constructor that initializes publisher diagnostics and its REST client using a selected API version or the literal 2026-02-01 fallback, then calls identifier validation.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: This collection scaffolding and initialization are supplied in Custom/HciClusterPublisherCollection.cs rather than Generated.

proposals.subtype: DEBUG-conditional collection identifier validation
proposals.explanation: Declares ValidateResourceId with Conditional("DEBUG") and throws ArgumentException when the identifier is not an HciClusterResource type. Calls are conditional at their call sites; this is not an unconditional production validation guarantee.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The conditional attribute and resource-type comparison are implemented in the Custom collection.

proposals.subtype: Publisher Get dispatches REST and wraps nonnull data in a resource
proposals.explanation: Implements sync/async Get with publisher-name validation, a GUID-parsed stored subscription, scoped REST dispatch, data deserialization, a RequestFailedException on null data and construction of HciClusterPublisherResource(Client,data), preserving the raw response and recording/rethrowing diagnostic failures.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The full public request/response method bodies are written in the Custom collection; this does not assert that every library client is handwritten.

proposals.subtype: Publisher collection maps paged data into bound publisher resources
proposals.explanation: GetAll/GetAllAsync create cancellation-bearing request contexts, construct the custom publisher data pageables with stored cluster scope and wrap them with selectors constructing HciClusterPublisherResource(Client,data). This item-shape adapter is distinct from the cited pager's next-link loop.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The explicit wrapper construction and data-to-resource selectors are implemented in the Custom collection.

proposals.subtype: Publisher existence helper treats 404 as a false result
proposals.explanation: Exists/ExistsAsync send GET directly, deserialize status 200, use null data for 404 and throw RequestFailedException for every other status. The bool result is data != null, with the original response attached; therefore even a null deserialized 200 value yields false.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The explicit status switch and boolean normalization are supplied in Custom/HciClusterPublisherCollection.cs.

proposals.subtype: Optional publisher Get returns NoValueResponse on missing data
proposals.explanation: GetIfExists/GetIfExistsAsync explicitly handle GET status 200 by deserializing and 404 by using null data, throwing for other statuses. Null data returns NoValueResponse<HciClusterPublisherResource>; otherwise data is wrapped in a bound publisher resource, preserving the raw response.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The status handling and nullable-resource return shape are implemented in the Custom collection rather than inferred from documentation.

proposals.subtype: Collection enumeration delegates to the public list pageables
proposals.explanation: Explicit generic/nongeneric sync enumeration delegates to GetAll().GetEnumerator(), while async enumeration forwards its cancellation token to both GetAllAsync and that pageable's GetAsyncEnumerator.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The three explicit interface implementations are supplied in the Custom collection outside Generated.
